QuestInfo.name: Peaceful Tea
QuestInfo.0: Ayan saw your dealings with Blackbull, and called you over.
QuestInfo.1: Although Blackbull is a strong warrior, he likes to give others a hard time. She was afraid you might not get along with him. Some nice tea might help you relax, so go see Sophia in the General Store for something soothing.
QuestInfo.2: You really should go see Sophia in the General Store, and have some nice tea to calm yourself down a bit.

0.0: Is Blackbull giving you a hard time, #h0#? He's a fine warrior...and a huge pain. Poor 10 Boogies is always the victim of his pranks, and she doesn't even know it. You should stay away from him. For now, I'd like you to see Sophia at the General Store.

yes.0: Sophia makes some lovely tea that will calm you right down. I'll tell Sophia that you're on your way.

no.0: Did I say I'd like you to go? I meant I WANT you to go. As in, NOW.

1.0: I've been waiting for you. Ayan told me what happened. Sorry, but I ran out of my calming tea. I've lit some aromatic candles instead, so come on in and take a load off.

npc.0: Go see Sophia. She will help relieve your stress. Do it NOW.
